Zurich, 18 September 2003

In its monetary policy assessment of 18 September 2003 , the Swiss National Bank decided to leave the target range for the three-month Libor rate unchanged at 0.0% to 0.75% and to continue to keep the three-month Libor rate at the lower end of the corridor at 0.25%.
Since March 2001, the National Bank has eased its monetary policy substantially, lowering the target range for the three-month Libor in seven steps by a total of 3.25 percentage points.
